**Finding: deviation (§ 12.1 License, p0149)**

The grant is "nonexclusive, **revocable**" with no trigger — effectively revocable at IBM's discretion — and runs to "Customer" alone, with § 14.17 (Limitation of Licenses) confirming no other rights are granted. Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf therefore have no path in. That fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory.

Successor transfer is already adequately covered by § 14.10 (Assignment), which permits assignment to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so no edit was needed there.

Redline (validated, preferred position): extends the licence to our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, and limits revocation to our material breach that remains uncured after written notice and a cure opportunity. Fallback offered in the comment: Affiliate coverage on written notice.
